definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP() AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR'            AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
"d"."Supplier","d"."BusinessPartner","d"."BusinessPartnerUUID","d"."BusinessPartnerCategory","d"."SupplierAccountGroup","d"."FormOfAddress","d"."InternationalLocationNumber1","d"."InternationalLocationNumber2","d"."InternationalLocationNumber3","d"."ReferenceAccountGroup","d"."SupplierAlternativePayee","d"."Customer","d"."PostingIsBlocked","d"."PurchasingIsBlocked","d"."VATLiability","d"."PaymentIsBlockedForSupplier","d"."SuplrProofOfDelivRlvtCode","d"."BR_TaxIsSplit","d"."IsActiveEntity","d"."AuthorizationGroup","d"."IsToBeAcceptedAtOrigin","d"."SupplierCorporateGroup","d"."ResponsibleType","d"."FiscalAddress","d"."SupplierProcurementBlock","d"."DataExchangeInstructionKey","d"."BPIsEqualizationTaxSubject","d"."BRSpcfcTaxBasePercentageCode","d"."DataMediumExchangeIndicator","d"."TranspServiceAgentStstcGrp","d"."TaxNumberResponsible","d"."TaxNumberType","d"."SuplrQualityManagementSystem","d"."SuplrQltyInProcmtCertfnValidTo","d"."SupplierIsSubRangeRelevant","d"."TrainStationName","d"."AlternativePayeeIsAllowed","d"."PaytSlipWthRefSubscriber","d"."SupplierIsPlantRelevant","d"."FactoryCalendar","d"."SupplierPlant","d"."DeletionIndicator","d"."IsBusinessPurposeCompleted","d"."PaymentReason","d"."SupplierCentralDeletionIsBlock","d"."DataControllerSet","d"."DataController1","d"."DataController2","d"."DataController3","d"."DataController4","d"."DataController5","d"."DataController6","d"."DataController7","d"."DataController8","d"."DataController9","d"."DataController10","d"."IsOneTimeAccount","d"."BusinessPartnerPanNumber" from "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_BUSINESSPARTNERSUPPLIER_S4_CURR" d

CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o
  ON o."BATCH_ID"      = b."BATCH_ID"
 AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
 AND o."OBJECT_NAME"   = 'I_BUSINESSPARTNERSUPPLIER'
